subject.title: improve(ui): move Settings navigation to the sidebar and unify page width

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a Settings-only sidebar with a shared 980px Settings workspace as the Control UI Settings direction after the collapsed-state defect is fixed?
rationale: The patch changes user-visible navigation structure and workspace layout across all Settings pages, which is a product/UX direction choice beyond routine bug repair.

options.title: Accept after repair and proof
options.body: Use the Settings-only sidebar direction, but require the collapsed-state fix and inspectable browser proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Keep only the least controversial workspace width cleanup and defer Settings navigation reorganization to a maintainer-owned design pass.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Keep the existing route-level Settings navigation for now and close or replace this PR with a smaller layout fix.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Use the Settings-only sidebar direction, but require the collapsed-state fix and inspectable browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI sidebar and navigation work makes this the best available owner for the Settings layout direction choice.
